attribution.note: Zitron's own words in his own post.

contract.note: Reading need as net cash burn, including prepayments, of about $20B+ per 3-6 months in H1 2026 is an ordinary plain reading. Separating money raised from money needed is fair.

FT projection of future negative free cash flow. It is a plan and bears on the open forward clause, not H1 2026.

reviews.rationale: The contract period is H1 2026. The only burn figure is Q1 at $3.7B, which points against the claim, but Q2 burn is missing.
